I found five Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers and sent you the list in our DM.

From Moss's notes (the "Central handoffs next week" digest, 2 Jan 2026):
  - #4409: a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. Hollis flagged it before the 5 Jan handoff.
  - #4412: a glitch in the driver text-message prompt when combine trailers are staged on unpaved overflow lots.

From #central-random this week:
  - #8841: Tobias posted on 13 Oct that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He called it "Tobias's dealer account", which points to Fieldworks, but it's worth checking with him or support. The Central weekly from 10 Feb 2025 uses #8841 for a Tansley Parcel printer jam.
  - PD-5302: Hollis posted on 14 Oct that this is a follow-up ticket from this week and needs no action.

Also:
  - #4419: Hollis's 15 Dec 2025 handoff email to you and Tobias mentions this one, for barcode scanner drop-offs at Salina yard gate 3.

I left out FR-882 (from the same Moss digest) and PD-4821 (from #central-team) because both are Marrow Agrisupply tickets, not Fieldworks. Moss's Central cheat sheet has no ticket numbers. Nothing turned up this week in #general, #help-it-ops or the Tansley carrier incident channel.
